context: Lead feedback: the product is functional but the visible customer chatbot still feels like a prototype. Prioritize this after the active core conversation tasks and before landing-page marketing polish.
requirements: Redesign the embeddable widget for premium mobile-first use: safe-area spacing, 44px minimum tap targets, full-width mobile sheet behavior, readable typography, and keyboard-safe composer.
Add concise quick actions for verified price, size/color, shipping, and human support; never fabricate product details or auto-send a message.
Present clear AI typing, delivery, and human-takeover states while continuing to accept customer messages after takeover.
Add focus states, Escape close, aria labels, reduced-motion support, and ensure no global CSS affects host websites.
Add product-card 'Hỏi tư vấn' CTA in the demo shop that opens the widget and prepares a grounded question.
acceptance_criteria: Single-script embed remains dependency-free and host CSS-safe.
390px mobile layout has no horizontal overflow and supports keyboard/accessibility controls.
Demo CTA opens the chat without automatically sending content; Core and E2E suites pass.

result.summary: Completed professional mobile-first customer chatbot experience with safe-area spacing, 44px tap targets, accessibility dialog controls, quick action chips, and product-card CTAs in demo storefront.
